arabic text: NA KALIM KA TASAWWAR – NA KHAYALE TOOR SINA
english translation text: NEITHER AN IMAGINATION OF THE PROPHET - NOR THE THOUGHT OF MOUNT SINAI

arabic text: MERI ARZOO MOHAMMAD – MERI JUS TAJU MADINA
english translation text: MY DESIRE IS MOHAMMED - MY HOPE IS MADINA

arabic text: MAY GHULAME MUSTAFA HUN – MERI AZMATAY NA PUCHO\nMUJE DEKH KAR JAHANNAM – KO BHI AA GAYA PASINA
english translation text: I AM THE SERVANT OF MUSTAFA - ASK NOT ABOUT MY GREATNESS\nFOR UPON MY SIGHT, THE FIRES OF HELL ITSELF SUBSIDE

arabic text: MUJE DUSHMANO NA CHERO – MERA HAY KOI JAHAN ME\nMAY ABHI PUKAR LOONGA – NAHI DUUR HAY MADINA
english translation text: O ENEMIES! DO NOT BULLY ME - I HAVE SOMEONE IN THIS WORLD\nI CAN CALL (UPON HIM) STRAIGHTAWAY - FOR MADINA IS NOT FAR

arabic text: MAY MARIZE MUSTAFA HUN – MUJE CHEDO NA TABIBO\nMERI ZINDAGI JO CHAHO, CHAHO – MUJE LE CHALO MADINA
english translation text: I AM THE PATIENT OF MUSTAFA - DO NOT BOTHER ME DOCTORS\nIF YOU WISH ME LONGEVITY, TAKE ME TO MADINA

arabic text: MERE DOOBNE ME BAKI – NA KOI KASAR RAHITHI\nKAHAN AL MADAD MUHAMMAD– TO UBHAR GAYA SAFINA
english translation text: THERE WAS NO DOUBT THAT I WOULD SINK\nBUT WHEN I SAID 'AL-MADAD MUHAMMAD' - MY ARK WAS BOUYANT AGAIN

arabic text: SIWA ISKE MERE DILME – KOI ARZOO NAHI HAY\nMUJE MOWT BHI JO AAYE, AAYE – TO HO SAMNE MADINA
english translation text: I HARBOUR NO DESIRE IN MY HEART OTHER THAN\nTHAT WHEN DEATH COMES UPON ME - IT SO HAPPENS IN MADINA

arabic text: KABHI AY GHULAM DILSE – NA MITE KHAYALE AHMAD\nISI ARZOO ME JINA, JINA - ISI ARZOO ME MARNA
english translation text: NEVER FROM YOUR HEART, O SLAVE, BE THE THOUGHT OF AHMAD ERASED\nLIVE WITH THIS DESIRE,\nAND DIE WITH THIS DESIRE
